correctness.rationale: Independently built the 30+120 tetrahedron facets from all fifteen printed four-element K6 edge labels, not from an asserted f-vector. Generated all subfaces and obtained f=(16,120,330,375,150), GF(2) boundary-d2 rank 104 and d1 rank 15, hence H1(F2) dimension (120-15)-104=1. Constructed the 45-edge gauge-fixed cocycle w(Ax)=0, w(xy)=[Axy is missing], checked w vanishes on all 330 facial triples and evaluates 1 on all 230 absent triples; each absent triple is therefore essential and all simple 3-edge minimizers are exhausted. Recovered the ten 3+3 letter bisections, induced all 720 S6 actions, verified facet preservation and exhaustive missing-triple orbits with sizes 20,60,90,60. The full automorphism designation relies on Lutz exact-object group identification; no integral-cycle conclusion is made.
risks: The combinatorial complex is identified with RP4 using the published exact construction, not by independently proving its global manifold homeomorphism.
